customManagers.description: Dockerfile base image digest (ARG NODE_DIGEST, FROM uses variables)

packageRules.description: npm: wait 7 days after publish (same policy as the former Dependabot cooldown; security fixes via vulnerabilityAlerts ignore this)
npm non-major updates in one PR
GitHub Actions: minor/patch/pin/digest in one PR (digest pins kept); majors get their own PR and are never merged automatically
GitHub Actions: wait 7 days after a new release (pin/digest refreshes of an already used tag are not delayed)
Automerge patch/pin/digest as a PR once ALL checks are green (Renovate itself waits for the checks, ignoreTests=false; no branch protection needed)
Automerge minor only for stable (non-0.x) versions; 0.x minors can break and get their own PR for review
0.x minors: separate PR per package, no automerge
h3 >=2 locked: Nuxt 4 / Nitro 2 (nitropack 2.13.x, @nuxt/nitro-server) depend on h3 ^1.15.11; h3 2 comes with Nitro 3 (beta). Revisit when Nuxt moves to Nitro 3.
satori >=0.48 locked: nuxt-og-image 7.0.7 peer is satori ^0.47.1 (0.x caret = <0.48); an override would violate the declared peer. Revisit when nuxt-og-image widens it.
typescript >=7 locked: typescript-eslint (all releases up to 8.72, peer <6.1) throws 'does not support TS 7.0', so lint breaks. Revisit when typescript-eslint supports TS 7.
package.json overrides (security pins, js-yaml 5 is allowed) never automerge; each gets its own review

package.json overrides: no major bump by Renovate. An override into a new major replaces the range the consumers declare (devalue 6 vs nuxt/nitro ^5, like the satori lock); do it by hand like js-yaml 5.
Node base image: digest/minor only, Node majors are a manual decision (engines.node >=26.12.0, Node 26 line)

description: Renovate config for MagguuUI-Website, same shape as MagguuBot. Minor/patch automerge as PR only after ALL checks are green (required checks on main: "build (26, false)" and "Analyze (javascript-typescript)"); majors and 0.x minors are never merged automatically. Locks are packageRules with a reason. Never run `npm audit fix --force`.
